title: Payment Terms Table for Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The payment terms below are the same on all six Credit Builder Accounts plans: the Credit Builder 600 Plan, Credit Builder 1000 Plan, Credit Builder 1200 Plan, Credit Builder 1800 Plan, Credit Builder 2400 Plan and Credit Builder 3000 Plan.

| Term | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Order in which a payment is applied | interest due, then principal of the installment, then unpaid fees, then additional principal |
| Treatment of amounts paid beyond the monthly payment | applied to principal; does not advance the next due date; the loan can be paid ahead to maturity |
| Smallest one-time payment | 5.00 USD |
| Largest single debit card payment | 500.00 USD |
| Same-day cutoff | 20:00 Eastern Time |
| Most one-time payments per calendar month, in addition to AutoPay | 4 |
| APR reduction for AutoPay | 0.0 percentage points |
| Due-day changes allowed over the life of the account | 1 |
| Statement closing | 21 calendar days before each due date |
| Statement delivery | electronic, in the online account |
| Penalty for paying off early | 0.00 USD |
| Payment deferral under a hardship program | not available |

## Notes on the terms

- **Same-day cutoff:** payments submitted by 20:00 Eastern Time on a business day are effective that day.
- **One-time payments per month:** the count is of one-time payments per account per calendar month; AutoPay debits are not counted against it.
- **Statement closing:** the monthly statement closes 21 calendar days before each due date.
- **Payment deferral:** payments cannot be deferred under a hardship program; Credit Builder has no hardship programs, and a borrower in hardship may close early instead.
- **AutoPay:** AutoPay carries no rate reduction on any plan.

## Illustrations (hypothetical payments)

| Payment | Within the terms? |
|---|---|
| a one-time ACH payment of 5.00 | yes, it is the smallest one-time payment |
| a one-time payment of 4.99 | no, below the 5.00 minimum |
| a debit card payment of 500.00 | yes, the largest single debit card payment |
| a debit card payment of 500.01 | no, above the 500.00 maximum |
| a fifth one-time payment in the same calendar month | no, at most 4 are taken |
